name: 08251 · Villas, NJ
findings: ZIP 08251 (Villas) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (70% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08251 (Villas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08251 (Villas) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
